Charcoal ankle-length formal coat, ivory shirt, muted blue-grey diagonal sash from HER/HIS RIGHT shoulder to LEFT hip, charcoal trousers and plain black boots. ONE square silver collar clasp. Calm grave face. No crown, no medals, tassels, decorative chains or weapon.
SHEET: landscape 2048x1536, three large equal-scale full-body orthographic views arranged left to right FRONT, HER RIGHT SIDE profile, BACK. Same neutral relaxed A-pose, feet aligned, entire head and both feet inside sheet, consistent height and identical clothing construction in every view. Character alone with empty hands. Do NOT include weapon, magic or detached props. Stowed case, scabbard or belt item may appear only when specified.
